idea-plugin.name: VeroScript
idea-plugin.description:
VeroScript language, running and debugging support for JetBrains Rider.

Features

  • Edit .vs files with syntax highlighting, brace matching and comment actions.
  • Use completion, hover documentation, diagnostics, navigation, semantic highlighting and formatting through the VeroScript language server.
  • Run scripts or check them without executing their entry point. Configure arguments, working directory, environment and compiler options.
  • Debug with the VM: line and conditional breakpoints, stepping, call stacks, variables, watches and expression evaluation.
  • Attach to a VeroScript DAP program host or a host-prepared debug domain.

Get started

  1. Install a matching VeroScript Runtime for your operating system and architecture. Keep the complete extracted directory, including its tools and native libraries.
  2. Open Settings > Languages & Frameworks > VeroScript and select the Runtime root. Project-specific and application-default Runtime paths are supported.
  3. Open a .vs file in a local Rider project. Use its context menu to run or check it, or create a VeroScript run/debug configuration.

Requirements and scope

Requires Rider 2026.2.2 (build 262.10315.191) or later within the 262 branch. Language services, Run, Check and local debugging require the separately installed Runtime. Basic syntax highlighting works without Runtime; attaching to a host-prepared debug domain does not require a local Runtime.

Ordinary Run supports VM, mixed and JIT execution when the Runtime provides the corresponding backend. Local debugging uses the VM. Host attachment features depend on the endpoint's capabilities.

Documentation

The source checkout includes this plugin's user and developer guides in its Resources/Docs directory, in English, French, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
